lede: Hammond celebrates Christmas in its downtown, with the Rotary Club's Christmas parade and a Polar Express night at the Columbia Theatre.
celebrates: Hammond's Christmas runs through Downtown Hammond. The Rotary Club of Hammond presents its 68th Annual Christmas Parade on December 5, with lights, floats, marching clubs and high school bands. The night before, the Columbia Theatre holds its annual Polar Express evening, with a decorated lobby, Santa, free hot cocoa from Candlestick Bakery and live carolers before the movie plays in Hainkel Hall. The Downtown Hammond calendar also lists a Kids Choir Christmas Program at First Baptist Church Hammond on December 6.
lastyear: The 2026 listings show the parade is the 68th annual, so last year's Hammond Christmas Parade was the 67th. The Rotary Club calls it a beloved Hammond tradition for nearly seven decades. The Columbia Theatre describes The Polar Express as an annual holiday tradition. These counts and descriptions come from the Rotary Club and the Downtown Hammond calendar.
facts: The Rotary Club of Hammond says its Christmas parade has been bringing the community together for nearly seven decades, with floats, marching clubs and high school bands. Businesses, organizations, civic groups, schools and auto clubs can enter through the club's registration page. The Columbia Theatre sits at 220 East Thomas Street, and its Hainkel Hall is where The Polar Express plays on the big screen after the lobby festivities.
trains: We found no train ride in Hammond with a verified 2026 date, but the Columbia Theatre's Polar Express evening on December 4 is the town's train-themed night, with the film shown on the big screen. For real train rides, see our Louisiana Christmas train rides guide.
traditions: The Rotary Club of Hammond's 68th annual parade through Downtown Hammond.
An annual pajama night at the Columbia Theatre with Santa and hot cocoa.
A PreK3 through 6th grade choir program at First Baptist Church Hammond.
kidfact: At the Polar Express night, guests are invited to wear pajamas and get free hot cocoa from Candlestick Bakery.
faq: With the Rotary Club of Hammond's Christmas Parade through Downtown Hammond and a Polar Express night at the Columbia Theatre.
Is the Hammond Christmas parade free?
Yes. Spectators line the streets of Downtown Hammond for free; only parade entries pay a fee.
Where can kids meet Santa in Hammond?
In the Columbia Theatre lobby at the Polar Express evening on December 4.
Is there a train ride in Hammond?
We did not find a verified train ride. The Polar Express movie night is the closest train-themed event.
